title: Gold Saver Account: Optimizing Your Balance for Maximum Interest
summary: This document explains Gold Saver Account tier boundaries and how to optimize interest by managing your balance relative to $37,500 and $112,500. It details three balance ranges (up to $37,500; above $37,500 to $112,500; above $112,500) and provides strategies for deposits/withdrawals plus periodic balance reviews.
